Sam R.: taking over the evening shift now — i'm primary for the next 8h. quick status before i fully sign in: any active pages? current known customer impact? @Priya K. can you confirm you're available as secondary?
Priya K.: here, i can do secondary for the next 4h, then @Jon H. will take the late window. no active P0s on my side. saw a brief 502 spike on /v1/embeds earlier but it recovered.
Sam R.: noted. Ops runbook link: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/oncall-handoff — i'll start with the incident checklist and run the quick health checks.
incident-bot: Pager triggered 10m ago — error_rate > 5% on /v1/generate across eu-west-1. Alert level: P1.
Maya L.: ^ from monitoring, sustained retry bursts from a small set of customers (cust-42, cust-88). downstream fanout to our batching service.
Sam R.: ok assigning roles to avoid overlap: Driver: Sam R. (me) — will own mitigation steps and rollout. Comms: Priya K. — will own status updates to #incidents and customers. Secondary/backup: Jon H.
Priya K.: got it. i'll draft the initial public incident note and ping support to flag cust-42 and cust-88.
Jon H.: confirmed, i'll be available if you need help with the kernel-level logs or to take over after 00:00 UTC.
Sam R.: first action: run quick smoke targets from eu-west-1: `curl -sS -X POST https://internal-proxy/eu-west-1/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'` — want to see latency and 502s. i'll paste results.
Sam R.: smoke results: 5/10 requests 502, avg latency 1.2s for successes. traces show timeouts at the batching frontend.
Maya L.: looking at batching queue: a spike in average batch size + CPU throttling on gpu-pool-03. Could be a bad client sending huge inputs.
Sam R.: mitigation plan: 1) throttle large token requests at the edge for eu-west-1 (temporary rule), 2) rotate GPU pool traffic to gpu-pool-05, 3) revert any recent model change on the hosted catalog if that's correlated.
Priya K.: drafting incident note now. short update: "P1: increased 502s for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 affecting a subset of customers. Driver assigned: Sam R.; Comms: Priya K.; mitigation in progress." will post to #incidents in 2m. :pencil2:
Sam R.: executing step 1 — applying request-size limiter rule. CLI: `rbctl edge-rules apply --region eu-west-1 --rule throttle-big-requests --max-tokens 2000`
ops-bot: edge rule throttle-big-requests applied to eu-west-1 by Sam R.
Sam R.: now starting traffic rotation off gpu-pool-03: `rbctl router shift --from gpu-pool-03 --to gpu-pool-05 --pct 50` (rolling). i'll monitor error rate.
Maya L.: metrics: error_rate dropped to 2.1% after 50% shift, batch sizes normalized. good sign.
Priya K.: posted update to #incidents and assigned support tickets for cust-42 and cust-88. adding the status page note: "We are mitigating increased error rates; engineers are actively rerouting traffic and applying temporary throttles."
Sam R.: next: check for config rollouts in the last 3 hours. @Jon H. can you pull deploy history for the model-serving infra? look for any quantization or kernel swaps.
Jon H.: scanning deploys... found a cosmetic kernel switch rolled at 18:17 UTC to gpu-pool-03 but marked as no-ops. will roll it back if needed.
Sam R.: hold rollbacks until we confirm correlation. priority is to keep customers online. We'll keep traffic on gpu-pool-05 until the end of my shift unless error rate climbs.
Priya K.: for handoff notes to the night crew: Driver=Sam R., Comms=Priya K., Secondary=Jon H., Current status: degraded -> improving (error_rate 2.1%), actions taken: throttled large requests, shifted traffic, monitoring. Runbook checkpoint: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/p1-handling section 2.3 for escalation.
Sam R.: perfect. if anything regresses while i'm on call i'll escalate to eng-runtime. otherwise i'll update again at 23:45 UTC for the next handoff.
incident-bot: Incident P1 (1912345678) status: mitigated -> partial_recovery.
Priya K.: leaving a note in the handoff doc: coverage gap 00:00-01:00 UTC if Jon's pager overlaps with infra maintenance — Jon pls confirm you'll be reachable.
Jon H.: i'll move my maintenance window, reachable via phone/email — no gap.
Sam R.: thanks all. final handoff checklist for whoever takes this: 1) check error_rate in eu-west-1, 2) verify edge-rule still active, 3) confirm GPU pool traffic distribution, 4) coordinate customer follow-ups.
Priya K.: i'll send a follow-up to support and mark tickets with "monitoring".
Sam R.: signing off to monitoring for now, driver remains until next update. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread for on-call handoff and incident ownership assignment. Contains bots, commands, and runbook links. All fields are strings or list of strings per schema.
